title: Parameter-Efficient Adaptation of Self-supervised Vision Backbones Survives Distribution Shift in Radar Micro-Doppler HAR
abstract: arXiv:2611.25874v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Micro-Doppler radar enables contactless, privacy-preserving human activity recognition (HAR), but deployment robustness remains underexplored. We compared full fine-tuning, frozen probing, and parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) using subject-disjoint in-distribution cross-validation and few-shot cross-age, cross-orientation, and cross-dataset transfer. Full fine-tuning suffered negative cross-dataset transfer, while frozen features under-adapted on cross-orientation. Only PEFT avoided both failures. We paired DINOv3 with all-layer principal-singular-direction adaptation (PiSSA), to our knowledge the first application of a self-supervised image foundation backbone to radar micro-Doppler HAR. DINOv3-PiSSA ranked first among PEFT methods in every evaluated setting. translated_title: 自监督视觉骨干网络的参数高效适配在雷达微多普勒人体活动识别中经受住分布偏移的考验
translated_abstract: 微多普勒雷达能够实现非接触式、保护隐私的人体活动识别（HAR），但其部署鲁棒性仍未得到充分研究。我们采用被试分离的同分布交叉验证以及少样本跨年龄、跨方向和跨数据集迁移实验，比较了全量微调、冻结探测和参数高效微调（PEFT）三种策略。结果显示，全量微调出现了负的跨数据集迁移，而冻结特征在跨方向场景下适应不足，只有PEFT避免了这两种失败。我们将DINOv3与全层主奇异方向适配方法相结合，据我们所知，这是自监督图像基础模型骨干首次应用于雷达微多普勒人体活动识别。DINOv3-PiSSA在所有评估设置中均在PEFT方法中排名第一。在我们的评估协议下，其Small变体仅使用3%的可训练参数和少4.5倍的总参数量，就达到了先前Base尺寸PEFT最先进方法的同分布准确率。
tldr: 本文首次将自监督视觉基础模型DINOv3与PiSSA参数高效微调相结合应用于雷达微多普勒人体活动识别，证明PEFT是唯一能同时避免跨数据集负迁移和跨方向欠适应的适配策略，其Small变体以4.5倍更少的总参数量即可达到先前最先进方法的同分布精度。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first application of a self-supervised vision foundation backbone (DINOv3-PiSSA) to radar micro-Doppler HAR, demonstrating that PEFT is the only adaptation strategy that avoids both negative cross-dataset transfer and cross-orientation under-adaptation, with its Small variant matching prior state-of-the-art in-distribution accuracy using 4.5x fewer total parameters.
